'''Dac Axfow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer with the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he was stationed in [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he always stayed close to the city's [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]].

Axfow showed signs of severe paranoia, expecting attacks from both members of the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at all times. He was always accompanied by his bodyguard, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Eryk Chinn]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Logro Elsin]], his personal [[Imperial pilot|pilot]].

Axfow had brown hair, freckles and showed signs of being overweight.

==Behind the scenes==
Dac Axfow was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
